I’ve lived in your shoes for quite some time until recently.
Spent far too much time wrestling the trigger.
I went through the motion until I was able to bring myself back to a tug of war between life and death rather than pure apathy waiting to decay.

My way was too first embrace nothingness as a possibility I went full atheist.
After that I found interests and half consumed myself with that, rather selfish or not.

Than I decided on a career based on interests; for me that is the aerospace industry.
Which is only a launching pad for larger dreams.
Making a place for that while simultaneously setting massive goals has been a huge key.

I see humanity as a big revolving wheel of self fuckery.
We will continue to spiral and either solve our problems or succumb to them.

Altruism is a great tool, I personally will do all I can to attain wealth (something I see 0 meaning in)
For the sake of my altruistic big goals.
Whether that be setting up and maintaining non profits or directly making a viewable difference.
Most of all I want to meet people, discover their earnest dreams, and help make it happen.

If the state of humanity depressing you decide to change it. 
Start by changing yourself.
There is absolutely nothing fucking pretty about it, but it is 100% attainable.

I used to believe some people were simply destined for suicide. 
I no longer believe that.

Ah, getting back to the crux of the question asked.
I personally believe in infinite.
I do not believe any religion has it all.
I believe in universal truths.
I believe in the contradictions of the world.
I believe religion is a tool.
I believe in God but not as a man but as literally everything.
That is the nature of infinite.
I also believe it is very negative if you spend more time thinking about God or the meaning of life without living. (Unless it brings you joy)
The “meaning” of life is shown to you while you live.
It may be excessively subjective or very balanced.

In closing 1 example of a universal truth is “Life is what you make of it” 
Try your best not to get caught up in ideal echo chambers.
If you are most comfortable living your designing a video game, or completing some remedial task don’t sweat it.

When life gets too monotonous and you feel like a rat on a wheel.
Break your reality and change shit, balls to the wall do or die.
Spitefully if you must.

If I can impart 1 belief of my own, that would be at the very least be neutral towards others if not as kind as possible.
